messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the long‑weekend periods in Canada for 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a weekday and is surrounded by a weekend, giving you at least three consecutive days off.)

| Date range | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|------------|------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, BC, NB, PEI) | Third Monday in February. |
| **Apr 7–10** | Good Friday & Easter Monday | Good Friday is a federal holiday; Easter Monday is a holiday in many provinces. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | First Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Dec 23–26** | Christmas Day (Dec 25) & Boxing Day (Dec 26) | Christmas Day fell on Monday, Boxing Day on Tuesday; together they give a four‑day break. |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., “St. Patrick’s Day” in Newfoundland & Labrador or “Civic Holiday” in Ontario), you’ll have to add those separately.  
> • For each long weekend, you can store the start and end dates, the holiday names, and whether the holiday was observed on a different day than its calendar date.  

Let me know if you’d like the data in a particular format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need province‑level details!
